Name: Actualiser les acteurs
Description: Met à jour les métadonnées pour les acteurs et réalisateurs dans votre médiathèque.

Name: Analyse des segments de média
Description: Extrait ou obtient des segments de média à partir des plugins compatibles avec MediaSegment.

Name: Analyser la médiathèque
Description: Analyse votre médiathèque pour trouver de nouveaux fichiers et actualise les métadonnées.

Name: Changer l'emplacement des images Trickplay
Description: Déplace les fichiers trickplay existants en fonction des paramètres de la bibliothèque.

Name: Clean Intro Skipper Cache
Description: Clear Intro Skipper cache of unused rows.

Name: Custom Tabs Startup
Description: Startup Service for Custom Tabs

Name: Detect and Analyze Media Segments
Description: Analyzes media to determine the timestamp and length of intros and credits.

Name: Extracteur d'images clés
Description: Extrait les images clés des fichiers vidéo pour créer des listes de lecture HLS plus précises. Cette tâche peut durer très longtemps.

Name: Extraire les images de chapitre
Description: Crée des vignettes pour les vidéos ayant des chapitres.

Name: Fetch Ratings from MDBList
Description:
Keeps MDBList ratings data fresh in the background for the item-details row and the sync task below.

• Looks up any movie/series whose cached MDBList data is missing or stale, and saves it; doesn't touch Jellyfin's own Community/Critic Rating fields.
• A found title stays cached for 7 days before being refetched (3 days for a confirmed "no match"); already-fresh titles are skipped entirely, so re-running this often, even daily, mostly costs nothing once the library's cache is warm.
• Stops once today's live remaining quota drops to the Fetch Task Reserve (config page), leaving that much for people browsing.
• Configure the trigger below to run this periodically so newly added items get picked up automatically.

Name: Générer des images Trickplay
Description: Crée des aperçus Trickplay pour les vidéos dans les médiathèques activées.

Name: Import Jellyfin Users to Seerr
Description:
Imports all Jellyfin users into Seerr so they can use Seerr Search without needing to visit the Seerr UI.

Already imported users are automatically skipped. Configure the task triggers to run this task periodically.

Name: JavaScript Injector Startup
Description: Cleans up legacy on-disk script injection and, if the request-time middleware is disabled, falls back to File Transformation / direct index.html injection.

Name: Jellyfin Enhanced Startup
Description: Initializes Jellyfin Enhanced background services and performs necessary cleanups. The client script is injected at request time by the injection middleware.

Name: MediaBar Startup
Description: Startup Service for MediaBar

Name: Mettre à jour les extensions
Description: Télécharge et installe les mises à jours des extensions configurées pour être mises à jour automatiquement.

Name: Nettoyer le dossier des transcodages
Description: Supprime les fichiers transcodés de plus d'un jour.

Name: Nettoyer le journal d'activité
Description: Supprime les entrées du journal d'activité antérieures à l'âge configuré.

Name: Nettoyer le répertoire des journaux
Description: Supprime les journaux de plus de 3 jours.

Name: Normalisation audio
Description: Analyse les fichiers à la recherche de données de normalisation audio.

Name: Optimiser la base de données
Description: Réduit les espaces vides ou inutiles et compacte la base de données. Utiliser cette fonction après une mise à jour de la médiathèque ou toute autre modification de la base de données peut améliorer les performances du serveur.

Name: PluginPages Startup
Description: Startup Service for PluginPages

Name: Refresh CDN Assets
Description: Downloads and refreshes the local copies of external CDN assets (icons, fonts, theme colours, logos) so clients are served them from the plugin instead of third-party CDNs. Runs on startup and every 24 hours.

Name: Refresh Tag Cache
Description: Builds the tag cache when needed, otherwise refreshes only entries for added, changed, and removed library items.

Name: Refresh Translation Cache
Description: Signals all clients to refresh cached translations on next page load. Runs on startup to ensure fresh translations after plugin updates.

Name: Refresh upcoming and missing episodes (TheMovieDb)
Description: Checks TheMovieDb for newly announced episodes and creates virtual entries for unaired and missing episodes, according to the TMDb plugin settings. When both options are disabled, removes any virtual entries previously created.

Name: Scan library for new box sets

LastExecutionResult.Name: Scan library for new box sets

Description: Scans all libraries for movies and adds them to box sets if the conditions are met

Name: Send Anonymous Usage Report
Description: Sends the opt-in anonymous usage report configured in the Jellyfin Enhanced Usage Statistics section. No-ops entirely unless enabled there, and skips silently until the configured reporting interval has elapsed.

Name: Spoiler Guard: apply to existing titles
Description: Turns Spoiler Guard on for every show and movie already in the library that is inside the auto-enable scope (content types and libraries), for every user who can see it. Titles a user already has, or has fully watched, are skipped. Run it by hand; rescans never do this.

Name: Sync Audio Language Tags to Jellyfin
Description: Adds each movie's and series' audio languages to Jellyfin items as metadata tags.

Name: Sync Ratings from MDBList to Jellyfin
Description:
Sets Community/Critic Ratings on movies and series from already-cached MDBList data (see the Fetch task above).

• Fills empty ratings only, by default; turn on "Overwrite Existing Ratings" (config page) to always match MDBList's current cached value instead.
• An item whose MDBList data hasn't been fetched yet (or lacks that specific source) is skipped, not treated as an error.
• Configure the trigger below to run this periodically so newly fetched items get synced automatically.

Name: Sync Tags from *arr to Jellyfin
Description:
Fetches tags from Radarr and Sonarr and adds them to Jellyfin items as metadata tags. 

 Configure the task triggers to run this task periodically for new items to be synced automatically.

Name: Sync Watchlist from Jellyfin to Seerr

LastExecutionResult.Name: Sync Watchlist from Jellyfin to Seerr

Description:
Syncs items from each user's Jellyfin watchlist to their Seerr watchlist.

Configure the task triggers to run this task periodically for automatic syncing.

Name: Sync Watchlist from Seerr to Jellyfin

LastExecutionResult.Name: Sync Watchlist from Seerr to Jellyfin

Description:
Syncs items from each user's Jellyseerr watchlist to their Jellyfin watchlist.

Configure the task triggers to run this task periodically for automatic syncing.

Name: Tâche de nettoyage des données utilisateur
Description: Nettoie toutes les données utilisateur (état de la montre, statut favori, etc.) des supports qui ne sont plus présents depuis au moins 90 jours.

Name: Télécharger les sous-titres manquants
Description: Recherche les sous-titres manquants sur Internet en se basant sur la configuration des métadonnées.

Name: Vider le répertoire cache
Description: Supprime les fichiers de cache dont le système n'a plus besoin.
